repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate re-reads the sensor inside the `if` condition instead of using the stored snapshot `h2`. The IR requires comparing the initial value `h1` against the value read after the delay (`h2`). The candidate computes `current_value - h2`, which changes the logic and potentially the triggering condition.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the sensor read in the `if` condition with the stored variable `h2` to match the IR's requirement of comparing two distinct snapshots taken 20 minutes apart.
